protocol_amendment: OE-LPV-1: prospectively allow recorded actuator limiting in this development integration. Require valid finite local fits, applied input/response bounds and settling for every cell. Preserve the historical zero-limiter gate failure. No cell exclusion by reference accuracy, no filter prerequisite, no claim of smooth acquisition.
scope: Three reused development fleets only. Frozen ClosedOE4 targets, original partial coverage, original L=7 group regression and inherited SmoothLocal strength. Clean-state OLS is a diagnostic. No trajectory generation, OE refits, controller rollout, new strength selection or confirmation unlock.
evaluation: Primary endpoint: equal-client then equal-fleet mean relative Frobenius A/B error on recipient-unobserved speeds. Report full/seen regions, separate A and B errors, entrywise absolute errors, spectral radii, paired fleet gains, smoothness sensitivity, group coverage and fixed-partition centralized agreement. Three development fleets: descriptive comparisons only.
